description: This file defines the interface 'PocketWritePlatformService' which provides methods for linking and delinking accounts related to 'pockets' within the Fineract project. It includes method signatures for processing commands related to these actions.

classes.name: PocketWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to link and delink 'pocket' related accounts within the system.

methods.name: linkAccounts
methods.description: Method to process a command that links accounts associated with 'pockets'.

methods.name: delinkAccounts
methods.description: Method to process a command that delinks accounts associated with 'pockets'.
